record.text: A model that thinks differently is most useful to me as a second reader. On a process where one wrong answer is costly, I'd have a different model check the first one's work and send the cases where they disagree to a person. That keeps review time on the cases that need it.

That last kind is the one I'd plan for. Format checks will pass a neat answer with one wrong fact in it. I'd keep a set of our own cases with known answers and rerun them after every change, so drift shows up as a number someone has to explain.

Title: Lines of a Life
Style: Fine-art portrait photography with a documentary, candid realism and a nostalgic, contemplational mood.
Prompt in ALT

images.alt:
An elderly woman sits seated and centered in a traditional wooden rocking chair, gazing calmly and directly toward the viewer with a composed, weathered expression. Her fine white hair is loosely gathered, with stray wisps catching the light, and her face is mapped with deep lines, fine wrinkles, and a few age spots, conveying decades of lived experience. Small teal disc earrings add a subtle touch of color against her skin. She wears a soft, faded gray v-neck t-shirt printed with a vintage-style pattern of faint lettering and muted pink and teal motifs, paired with dark blue jeans. The most striking feature is her extensive blackwork tattooing: both arms are covered from the upper sleeve down through the hands and onto individual fingers, displaying script lettering, starburst and sun-like symbols, floral and abstract designs—an unexpected juxtaposition with her age that suggests a bold, nonconforming life. Behind her, the chair's backrest holds a floral cushion, and to the right a tall window draped with a sheer white curtain admits soft natural daylight, with blurred greenery visible beyond the glass. The walls are a muted olive-tan, the floor softly carpeted, lending the intimate domestic scene a quiet, contemplative dignity.
Style: Fine-art portrait photography with a documentary, candid realism and a nostalgic, contemplational mood.
Composition: Medium-format, eye-level frontal portrait; the subject is centered in a symmetrical arrangement within the rocking chair, her tattooed forearms and hands framing the lower third, the window and curtain balancing the right side and providing depth.
Lighting: Soft, diffused natural window light from the right, gentle and directional, creating subtle modeling on the face and arms while keeping shadows soft and warm.
Adjectives: Dignified, weathered, contemplative, defiant, intimate.
